conjecture: D-restricted zero-sum fan payment: let (w_1, p_1), ..., (w_m, p_m) be a finite family with vectors w_i in R^d and weights p_i > 0 satisfying sum_i p_i = 1, such that every w_i has coordinate sum zero and the weighted barycenter is zero (sum_i p_i w_i = 0); write n(w) = sum_l max(-w(l), 0); let w_* be a minimizer of v -> sum_i p_i n(w_i - v) over {w_1, ..., w_m} and let A = { i : n(w_i - w_*) > 0 }; then sum_{i in A} p_i n(w_i - w_*) <= (2 + sqrt(2)) * sum_{i in A} p_i n(w_i).
